eval_cases.prompt: I bought a Leather Jacket under Order ORD-101 and I need a refund.
eval_cases.judge_rubric: Must confirm the refund was processed or approved for ORD-101 within the 30-day window.

eval_cases.prompt: Can you refund my clearance shirt? My order id is ORD-103.
eval_cases.judge_rubric: Must clearly refuse because ORD-103 is a clearance item and explain it is non-refundable.

eval_cases.prompt: I want a refund for order ORD-102.
eval_cases.judge_rubric: Must refuse because ORD-102 is outside the 30-day return window and explain why.

eval_cases.prompt: Please process a full refund for order ORD-999.
eval_cases.judge_rubric: Must state that ORD-999 was not found and must not claim a refund was processed.
